title.zh: 企業資本配置與財務工程戰略 (CFO 資本回報視角)
title.en: Corporate Capital Allocation & Financial Engineering (CFO Perspective)

slide_title.zh: 資本效率現狀與價值解鎖訴求 (SCQA & The CFO Ask)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：公司目前持有高達 [X 億] 的閒置現金，且旗下包含高成長的核心科技業務與低利潤的傳統製造業務
衝突 (Complication)：資本市場因我們業務過於龐雜，給予了嚴重的「集團折價 (Conglomerate Discount)」，導致股價被嚴重低估，極易引來惡意併購
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：全面重塑資本配置戰略，懇請董事會授權啟動 [特定業務] 的分拆 (Spin-off) 評估，並啟動 [X 億] 規模的庫藏股買回計畫
en: Situation: The enterprise currently holds [$X] in excess cash on the balance sheet, operating a mix of high-growth tech units and low-margin legacy manufacturing.
Complication: The capital markets are penalizing us with a severe 'Conglomerate Discount' due to operational complexity, drastically undervaluing our stock and inviting hostile takeovers.
The Ask: Overhauling our capital allocation strategy. Requesting Board mandate to initiate feasibility studies for a Spin-off of [Specific BU] and authorization for a [$X] Share Buyback program.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，我們現在面臨一個『富裕的煩惱』。我們帳上現金滿滿，但股價卻一灘死水。華爾街最討厭看不懂的公司，我們把高成長跟低毛利的業務綁在一起，市場就直接給我們打折（集團折價）。今天的提案，是財務部要透過『資本配置』的魔術，把隱藏在財報裡的股東價值，硬生生地榨出來。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, we are suffering from a 'rich man's problem.' Our balance sheet is flush with cash, yet our stock price is stagnant. Wall Street punishes complexity; by coupling our high-growth assets with low-margin legacy operations, the market is applying a severe 'Conglomerate Discount.' Today's mandate leverages elite capital allocation to surgically extract and unlock the shareholder value trapped within our financials.

slide_title.zh: 資本回報率與跨部門資源重分配 (ROIC vs. WACC)

zh: 價值創造底線 (The Hurdle Rate)：全面檢視各事業群 (BU) 的投入資本回報率 (ROIC)，凡是 ROIC 連續三年低於加權平均資本成本 (WACC) 的業務，將停止任何擴張性 CapEx
現金牛 vs. 燒錢坑 (Cash Cows vs. Cash Traps)：將傳統業務定調為「現金牛」，榨取其自由現金流 (FCF)，全數轉移注資至 ROIC 高於 [X]% 的核心增長引擎
無情停損 (Ruthless Rationalization)：針對無法轉虧為盈的邊緣業務，啟動業務剝離 (Divestiture) 或清算，停止破壞整體股東價值
en: The Hurdle Rate: Auditing the Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) across all BUs. Any unit where ROIC fails to clear the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) for 3 consecutive years faces an immediate CapEx freeze.
Cash Cows vs. Cash Traps: Reclassifying legacy units as 'Cash Cows' to harvest Free Cash Flow (FCF), redirecting 100% of those funds to core growth engines yielding ROIC > [X]%.
Ruthless Rationalization: Initiating divestitures or liquidation for non-core, value-destroying operations to immediately halt the dilution of overall shareholder equity.

speaker_notes.zh: 財務部的第一把刀，是 ROIC 對決 WACC。白話來說，如果一個部門賺錢的回報率，比我們向銀行借錢的利息還低，那它就是在『毀滅價值』。我們將無情地切斷這些部門的資金，把傳統業務當作提款機，把錢全部砸向我們最高回報的核心增長引擎。沒有感情，只有數字。
speaker_notes.en: The CFO's primary weapon is the ROIC versus WACC equation. Simply put, if a Business Unit's return is lower than our cost of borrowing, it is actively destroying enterprise value. We will ruthlessly sever CapEx to these cash traps, treating them strictly as ATMs to fund our high-yield growth engines. This is about mathematical reality, not emotional attachment.

slide_title.zh: 資產分拆與業務剝離戰略 (Spin-off & Divestiture Strategy)

zh: 解除集團折價 (Unlocking the Discount)：提議將 [高成長科技業務] 獨立分拆 (Spin-off) 上市，讓資本市場能給予其專屬的、更高的本益比 (P/E Ratio) 估值
母子雙贏 (Pure-Play Valuation)：分拆後，母公司股票將成為穩健收息股 (Dividend Play)，子公司將成為成長股 (Growth Play)，精準吸引不同屬性的投資人
剝離非核心 (Strategic Divestiture)：將 [特定非核心業務] 出售給私募股權基金 (PE)，獲取一次性鉅額現金注入，進一步充實母公司戰略銀彈
en: Unlocking the Discount: Proposing the Spin-off of [High-Growth Tech Unit] into a standalone public entity, allowing capital markets to apply a pure-play, premium P/E multiple.
Pure-Play Valuation: Post-spin, the Parent becomes a high-yield Dividend Play, while the SpinCo becomes an aggressive Growth Play—surgically targeting two distinct investor bases.
Strategic Divestiture: Carving out and selling [Non-Core BU] to Private Equity (PE) to inject massive one-time liquidity, reloading the Parent company's strategic war chest.

speaker_notes.zh: 我們最大的問題是『什麼都做，但市場什麼都不買單』。透過 Spin-off (分拆)，我們把高成長的部門切出去獨立上市。這會產生魔法般的化學反應：喜歡高股息的投資人買母公司，喜歡高風險高成長的投資人買子公司。這樣『純粹 (Pure-play)』的估值，能瞬間把我們隱藏的數百億市值釋放出來。
speaker_notes.en: Our fundamental issue is being a 'jack of all trades, valued at none.' Through a Spin-off, we carve out our high-growth division into an independent public company. This creates a financial alchemy: yield-seeking investors buy the Parent, while aggressive growth investors buy the SpinCo. Creating these 'pure-play' entities will instantly unlock billions in trapped market capitalization.

slide_title.zh: 股東回報：庫藏股買回 vs. 股息發放 (Buybacks vs. Dividends)
slide_title.en: Shareholder Returns: Share Buybacks vs. Dividends

zh: 庫藏股買回 (Share Repurchase)：鑑於目前股價低於我們內部計算的內在價值 (Intrinsic Value) [X]%，強烈建議啟動 [X 億] 庫藏股買回，實質推升每股盈餘 (EPS)
特別股息 (Special Dividend)：相較於常規配息，若業務剝離產生鉅額現金，提議發放「一次性特別股息」，避免墊高未來每年的配息壓力
防禦性資本 (Defense Capital)：透過買回自家股票，減少市場外的流通籌碼，亦能大幅提高敵意併購者 (Hostile Acquirers) 的收購成本
en: Share Repurchase (Buybacks): Given our stock is trading [X]% below its calculated Intrinsic Value, we strongly recommend a [$X] Share Buyback program to financially engineer higher Earnings Per Share (EPS).
Special Dividend: Utilizing one-time liquidity from divestitures for a 'Special Dividend,' rewarding shareholders without permanently inflating our recurring dividend obligations.
Defense Capital: Retiring outstanding shares not only boosts EPS but consolidates ownership, structurally elevating the financial barrier for any hostile acquirers.

speaker_notes.zh: 帳上現金太多，如果找不到好項目投資，我們就必須還給股東。目前我們的股價被嚴重低估，這是啟動『庫藏股買回 (Buyback)』的黃金時機。把股票買回來註銷，外面的籌碼變少，每股盈餘 (EPS) 自動上升，股價自然會漲。同時，這也是最好的防禦武器，讓外面的禿鷹買不起我們。
speaker_notes.en: Excess cash must be returned to shareholders if we lack high-ROI internal projects. With our stock currently trading at a steep discount to its intrinsic value, a Share Buyback is the highest-ROI investment we can make. Retiring shares mathematically inflates our EPS, driving the stock price up. Simultaneously, reducing the public float makes us significantly more expensive for hostile raiders to target.

slide_title.zh: 180 天財務工程藍圖與決策訴求 (180-Day Blueprint & The Ask)

zh: 第 1-60 天 (顧問遴選與盡調)：聘請 [頂級投行如 Goldman Sachs/Morgan Stanley] 擔任財務顧問，啟動分拆業務的稅務與法務盡職調查 (Due Diligence)
第 61-120 天 (S-1 提交與路演)：向證管會 (SEC) 提交分拆上市文件 (S-1/Form 10)，並啟動針對大型機構法人的非交易路演 (NDR)
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會今日正式核准 [X 億] 的庫藏股買回額度，並授權 CFO 辦公室編列千萬級預算啟動分拆上市之先期顧問作業
en: Days 1-60 (Advisory & Due Diligence): Retaining Tier-1 Investment Banks (e.g., Goldman Sachs/Morgan Stanley) to execute rigorous tax and legal Due Diligence on the target SpinCo.
Days 61-120 (Regulatory Filings & NDR): Filing the Form 10/S-1 with the SEC and launching Non-Deal Roadshows (NDR) to pre-market the SpinCo to top-tier institutional whales.
Call to Action: Requesting immediate Board authorization for the [$X] Share Buyback program and approving the multi-million advisory budget to officially launch the Spin-off protocol.

speaker_notes.zh: 資本配置的變革是一項精密的財務工程。這是我們的 180 天藍圖。前兩個月，我們需要頂尖投行與四大會計師事務所進駐，確保分拆過程不會產生天文數字的稅金。為了展現我們捍衛股價的決心，我懇請董事會今天就核准這筆庫藏股買回預算，並授權我們啟動分拆計畫。是時候把價值還給我們的股東了。
speaker_notes.en: Transforming capital allocation is a highly precise financial engineering operation. Here is the 180-day blueprint. The first two months require Tier-1 bankers and Big-4 auditors to structure the spin-off tax-efficiently. To immediately signal our commitment to defending the stock price, I ask the Board to authorize the Buyback program today, and fund the advisory retainers to ignite the Spin-off. It is time to unlock our true value for our shareholders.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『企業資本配置與財務工程』簡報。受眾為董事會、投資人或資本市場。內容必須展現 CFO (財務長) 捍衛並解鎖股東價值的頂級財技思維：1. 運用 SCQA 點出企業滿手現金卻遭遇『集團折價 (Conglomerate Discount)』的窘境，2. 以 ROIC 與 WACC 為基準，無情切斷低效部門的資本支出 (CapEx)，3. 探討透過業務分拆 (Spin-off) 或剝離 (Divestiture) 創造純粹估值 (Pure-Play) 的魔力，4. 對比『庫藏股買回 (Share Buyback)』與『特別股息』在推升 EPS 與防禦敵意併購上的戰略差異，5. 結尾給出 180 天投行合作藍圖，並要求董事會授權鉅額庫藏股買回與顧問預算。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具華爾街投行水準、數字至上且冷靜無情。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Corporate Capital Allocation & Financial Engineering' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, Investors, or Capital Markets. Demonstrate the CFO's elite financial mastery in defending and unlocking shareholder value: 1. Use SCQA to frame the dilemma of high cash reserves paralyzed by a 'Conglomerate Discount.' 2. Use ROIC vs. WACC as the ruthless mathematical hurdle to sever CapEx to underperforming BUs. 3. Architect Spin-offs and Divestitures to create premium 'Pure-Play' valuations. 4. Contrast Share Buybacks vs. Special Dividends, proving how buybacks mathematically inflate EPS and defend against hostile raiders. 5. Conclude with a 180-Day Investment Banking roadmap, demanding immediate Board authorization for massive Buybacks and advisory retainers. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must be Wall Street-grade, ruthlessly quantitative, and devoid of emotional attachment to legacy assets.
